notes.title: Ganbatte releases on April 19! Launch trailer revealed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31033179/663f78cc65f80957268913342d196b4c79198d34.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ganbatte out on April 19[/h1]
Hey everyone, we have some important news that we want to share with you. 

[h1]Save the Date[/h1]
We're thrilled to announce the release date for our early access launch: 
[b]--> Thursday April 19th, 2018 <--[/b]

We can’t wait for you to try out the first public version of Ganbatte. We’re already proud of Ganbatte in its current form and we look forward to an exciting journey ahead where we get to make it even better with your help! If you haven’t done so yet, check out our Steam Store page and wishlist it so you can be the first to get it!

[h1]Launch Trailer Reveal[/h1]
An upcoming release deserves a new shiny trailer to celebrate it. Therefore, in anticipation of Thursday's release, we present to you the official Ganbatte Early Access Launch Trailer.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pGAsF0f56Bk] Watch on Youtube[/url]

[h1]Win a Ganbatte Steam key![/h1]
We're giving away 10 Steam keys for Ganbatte.
For a chance to win, simply:
[list]
    [*]Like & Retweet [url=https://twitter.com/MimicryGames/status/985954120346546180]this tweet[/url]
    [*]Make sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/MimicryGames]@MimicryGames[/url]
[/list]
OR
[list]
    [*]Like, share & comment [url=https://www.facebook.com/mimicrygames/videos/1519272338181882/]this facebook post[/url]
[/list]
*Winners will be announced via DM or facebook on April 19, 9am PT.

[h1]Quick-links[/h1]
[list]
    [*][url=http://press.mimicrygames.com/sheet.php?p=ganbatte]Press Kit[/url]

For press inquiries please contact press@mimicrygames.com
 
[h1]Grab the Latest Screenshots[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31033179/6db217b36a84b39741fb68c28c80294f9d1273d8.jpg[/img]
That's right, we have created a new batch of high-resolution screenshots. 
Grab them while they're still hot up on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/691680/Ganbatte/]Ganbatte Steam Store page[/url].

[h1]On a personal note[/h1]
Ganbatte’s devblog is live and we have been sharing our experiences and insights there. In case you’re up for some reads, I would like to personally recommend [url=https://ganbattegame.com/blog/2018/04/03/travel-vlog-and-release-window]“Travel vlog and release window”[/url].

As we’re getting closer to releasing our first version, here on Steam, more news and updates will keep coming your way!

Thanks for reading and 'till the next one!

- Daniela
